name: ui-review help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:ui-review. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Reopen
entries.text: Puts a decided item back in the waiting list.

entries.title: Waiting
entries.text: Items still waiting for your decision.

entries.title: Screens list
entries.text: Shows or hides the list of screens beside the pictures.

entries.title: Previous screen
entries.text: The picture of the screen before this one.

entries.title: Next screen
entries.text: The picture of the next screen.

entries.title: Previous screen, every column
entries.text: Steps every column back one screen together, so phone and desktop stay lined up.

entries.title: Next screen, every column
entries.text: Steps every column on one screen together, so phone and desktop stay lined up.

entries.title: Re-capture
entries.text: Takes this screenshot again from the live app and replaces the picture that failed to load.

entries.title: Wait for my look approval before UI builds start
entries.text: On: a build that changes UI waits in UI Review until you approve its predicted look; Reject holds it. Off: it starts straight away.

entries.title: More
entries.text: Part of the predicted mockup: stands in for the screen's More menu. It does nothing here.

entries.title: Options every build ships
entries.text: Where you set “Options every build ships”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Ask me how many options before a build makes them
entries.text: Turns “Ask me how many options before a build makes them” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Minutes to wait for my answer
entries.text: Where you set “Minutes to wait for my answer”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of UI Review.

entries.title: Show everything
entries.text: Clears the group a phone notification opened, so the whole queue shows again.

entries.title: Go ahead when UI Review waits too long
entries.text: When an item sits unanswered for the timeout, it goes ahead with the build's recommended option (or is approved), marked “auto-approved after timeout”, so the build keeps going and lands. Off = items and their builds wait for you.

entries.title: Timeout
entries.text: How long an item can wait unanswered before it goes ahead (default 1 hour).

entries.title: Tell my phone when it goes ahead
entries.text: AmberX gets “UI Review: <build> waited 1 h, going ahead with <option>”. A tap opens the item.

entries.title: File a follow-up build when I change it afterwards
entries.text: Pick another option, Ask changes or Reject on an auto-approved item and a build is filed to match your decision.

entries.title: Applies to
entries.text: Every item, or only items with a PR or branch (the ones holding a merge).

entries.title: Open UI Review on each new item
entries.text: A new item opens UI Review on it (with Follow Amber on).

entries.title: Undo
entries.text: Re-opens an item that went ahead after the timeout: it waits for you again and its clock restarts.
